notes: OBS no longer tanks your FPS: the FPS Boost mod now really detects recording (OBS/Streamlabs/etc.), caps FPS to a stable 60 while recording so the encoder keeps up (no more 90->30 swings), and never lets AFK throttle mid-stream. Plus the new Stutter Guard: potato/turbo PCs cap FPS at 120 instead of running uncapped, which stops the multi-second freezes at 200 FPS on 2-core laptops.
